title: Detailed helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Main rotor blur -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='38' ry='5' fill='#8899bb' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- Top rotor blades -->
  <rect x='14' y='16' width='72' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#aabbdd'/>
  <rect x='47' y='8' width='6' height='11' rx='2' fill='#ccddef'/>
  <!-- Rotor hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='4' fill='#99aacc'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='2' fill='#ddeeff'/>
  <!-- Tail boom -->
  <rect x='58' y='44' width='28' height='6' rx='2' fill='#4a8f5f'/>
  <!-- Tail rotor -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='47' r='8' fill='#6688aa' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='47' r='2' fill='#aabbcc'/>
  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <path d='M82 38 L92 38 L90 50 L82 50 Z' fill='#3d7a4f'/>
  <rect x='83' y='38' width='2' height='12' rx='1' fill='#66bb88'/>
  <!-- Tail rotor blades -->
  <rect x='84' y='39' width='4' height='16' rx='2' fill='#88aacc'/>
  <rect x='78' y='45' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#88aacc'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='52' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#44aa66'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='49' rx='22' ry='12' fill='#55cc77'/>
  <!-- Cockpit window -->
  <path d='M22 44 Q18 52 22 58 Q30 62 38 60 Q40 52 38 44 Q30 40 22 44 Z' fill='#88ddff'/>
  <path d='M24 46 Q21 52 24 56 Q30 59 36 57 Q37 52 36 46 Q30 43 24 46 Z' fill='#bbeeff'/>
  <!-- Window shine -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='48' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Body stripe -->
  <path d='M18 54 Q38 62 58 54' stroke='#2d8855' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Skid landing gear -->
  <rect x='24' y='66' width='28' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2d7744'/>
  <rect x='28' y='58' width='3' height='9' rx='1' fill='#3d8f55'/>
  <rect x='45' y='58' width='3' height='9' rx='1' fill='#3d8f55'/>
  <!-- Skid tips -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='67.5' r='2' fill='#1d6634'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='67.5' r='2' fill='#1d6634'/>
  <!-- Engine exhaust -->
  <rect x='52' y='44' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#336644'/>
  <!-- Nose light -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#ffee44'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='52' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Mast -->
  <rect x='47' y='30' width='6' height='14' rx='2' fill='#7a9abb'/>
  <!-- Doot's face on the side -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='52' r='5' fill='#1a3325'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#66ffaa'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#66ffaa'/>
  <path d='M32 55 Q34 57 36 55' stroke='#66ffaa' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
